Tweet by @vercel_dev (Vercel Developers)
Author bio: For developers building on @vercel.
Text: Introducing Vercel Managed Images.

Vercel Sandbox now ships with:
▪︎ Ubuntu as the default OS
▪︎ Preinstalled coding agents (𝚌𝚘𝚍𝚎𝚡, 𝚌𝚕𝚊𝚞𝚍𝚎…)
▪︎ Customizable, open source base images

Try the new base image:
